description_en: Queries the push status list of cloud application service instances for a file. Paging is supported for paged query
description_zh: 查询文件的云应用服务实例推送状态信息列表，支持分页查询
kebab_example: aliyun vs list-file-push-statuses --file-id f-1671accd4dafdag3er256cvgewt13f7141db2f7 --rendering-instance-id render-9f8c57355d224ad7beaf95e145f22111 --file-name myfile --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --start-time 2025-06-17T12:16:00Z --end-time 2025-06-23T02:13:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListFilePushStatuses

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file, which uniquely identifies the file
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the cloud application service, which is used to query the files installed on the specified instance
parameters.help_zh: 云应用服务实例ID，用于查询指定实例上安装的文件
parameters.name: rendering_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list to query. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
查询列表的页码。起始值为1。
默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The Settings for the number of entries per page during paging in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，取值范围1～100。
默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The start time for the time range filter. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 时间区间筛选参数。按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The start time for the time range filter. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 时间区间筛选参数。按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned list

PageSize.description_en: The Settings for the number of entries per page during paging in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数
PageSize.title_en: 分页查询时设置的每页行数
PageSize.title_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数

PushStatuses.description_en: The list of file push statuses

PushTime.description_en: The start time of the push. The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard with time zone offset in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss+HH:mm format
PushTime.description_zh: 预推开始时间，采用 ISO 8601 标准并包含时区偏移，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss+HH:mm

RenderingInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the cloud application service

Doing
